caption: The drawing depicts two ceramic objects placed vertically on a plain, beige background. The upper object is a lidded sugar bowl with ornate curving handles on each side and a knob-like finial on top. The lower object is a teapot, also with a lid featuring a similar finial, a curved spout on the left, and a handle on the right. Both objects are predominantly white or ivory in color, and each features a painted brown monochrome landscape scene with buildings and trees in the center and on the lid, matching in style and tone. The shading and highlights on the objects suggest a slight sheen and curvature of the ceramic surfaces. There is a visible artist signature, "Frances Lichten," in small text near the bottom right corner.
title: Sugar Bowl and Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
